_doc: Render massing for Station Kortrijk (OSM way 114133992, GRB 7711874), read by pipeline/src/scene.ts. Metres in Lambert 72 around 'anchor' (centre of the 2024 orthophoto crop refs/top-station), u = grid east, v = grid north; the canopies and the bike parking were traced on that orthophoto (0.2 m/px). Look (Commons refs/, Street View look-up): post-war station of buff brick with a raised central hall and flat light roofs; on the track side a dark canopy along platform 1 and four long light grey island canopies (partly glazed) on slim columns; south of the tracks a long covered bike parking clad in timber slats. Canopies are boxes from the ground (parts cannot float): low, with dark 'walls' that read as the shade under the roof. Island canopies are 8 m wide around their centre lines (the traced strips include the platform edges), so the tracks show between them.
